_doc: T-126: Flt Lt Harry Selwyn, GRAVELIGHT ONE's pilot, pinned in the crushed cockpit of Map 0's wreck (gravelight/world/trapped_pilot.gd). Hand him a gun from the cabin and he fights from his seat. range_m: how far he engages; max_yaw_deg: how far he can twist either way from straight ahead; fire_cone_deg: how close his aim must be before he fires; turn_rad_s: how fast he turns; rate_mult / rate_cap: his fire rate from the gun's rpm (a wounded man), capped; spread_mult / spread_add_deg: his cone, from the gun's aimed spread; head_chance: the share of shots he aims at the head; reload_mult: his reload time from the gun's; refused_classes: guns he won't take (also anything with a projectile or a stream); hold_s: the hold to hand over a gun or ammo; eye_y: his eye over the cockpit floor (line-of-sight checks); call_every_s / call_within_m: while unarmed he calls to anyone in the wreck this often; kill_line_every: a line every n kills; look: his PatronBody colours (linear-ish RGB 0..1, as map00_opening.json patrons). display: his subtitle name; line_cooldown_s: per category, the least gap between two of his lines (lines.json speaker SEL).
